name: Signet of the Vess Veil
text:
You start the game with 2 less life.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if it's that player's second turn, that player discards a card.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, if it's that player's third turn, that player discards a card.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, if it's your second turn, add {B}.
